title: test(app-shell): pin that a failed feed read does not carry over to another record (#30145)
body:
Fixes #30145

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:给记录详情页的"动态/评论读取失败"提示补了一组测试,确认切换到另一条记录时不会带着上一条记录的失败提示。没有改产品代码。
- 为什么改:#29188 已经上线了失败提示和重试;本卡剩下的验收句是"读取失败期间切换记录,错误不能带到新记录",此前没有测试钉住。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个测试文件,无运行时影响;回滚即还原该文件。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.feedLoadFailure-29188.test.tsx` 的新 describe 块和顶部 rig 的两处小扩展(`byRecord`、`failGet` 的 `object@record` 写法)。
- 两分钟验证:在仓库 `ui/` 目录运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.feedLoadFailure-29188.test.tsx`,预期 14 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(本 PR 测试-only,请席位给 `skip-changeset`)。

## What changes

Adds a top-level `describe` to the existing #29188 pin file (per the shared-harness ruling) with four cases that change the record on a mounted `RecordDetailView`, the way the Console and the drawers do (swap `recordIdOverride`, no remount):

1. Record A settled on a comments failure; record B answers empty: B shows the empty state, no notice, no Retry.
2. Record A failed on both streams; record B answers with rows: B draws its rows and no notice.
3. A's page read is still outstanding when B is opened, B settles, then A's failure lands late: B stays clean (payload path).
4. Same late-settle order on the direct `sys_comment` read path.

The rig gains `byRecord` (per-record page answers) and an `object@record` form of `failGet`.

## Tests

- Pin on current main (no product change): 14 passed (14); the 4 new cases are green.
- Reverse check (mutation, then restored, `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards): made the feed verdict read any record's failed verdict instead of the current record's. All 4 new cases went red, the 10 older cases stayed green. Direction observed: red (expected). The pin can fail; main simply has no carry-over, because the feed verdict is already keyed by record.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` passed; the derived gate families passed (see the report on the card).

## Acceptance notes

- Triage's narrowing holds: the error state with Retry shipped in #29188; the carry-over the card names does not exist on main, so no `RecordDetailView.tsx` change and no changeset. Test-only; `skip-changeset` requested from the seat.
- `check:type-check-debt` did not finish inside the 280 s local window (exit 124): NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI. The diff adds no type-debt-bearing code.

## Verification

Run on the final head with the shared verify lock: the file above, 14 of 14 passed.
